// Operator-reviewed metadata, not autonomous network discovery.
const uuid = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const groups = JSON.parse($env.MCP_HUB_JEMS_REQUIRED_GROUP_IDS || '[]');
if (!Array.isArray(groups) || groups.some(g => typeof g !== 'string' || !uuid.test(g))) throw new Error('MCP_POLICY_INVALID');
const tenant = String($env.ENTRA_TENANT_ID || '').trim().toLowerCase();
const server = {"server_name": "jems", "endpoint": "https://emr-jems-stage.rechenwerk.com/sse", "transport": "sse", "tools": [{"name": "jems_languages_list", "description": "
<usecase>
WHAT: Lists the fallback language and all available language codes supported by JEMS translations.
WHEN: Use before jems_project_fetch when you need to select a language or confirm the fallback language.
NOT: Does not translate arbitrary text; it only exposes supported language tags.
</usecase>

<instructions>
PARAM RULES:
- none; call without parameters.
VALUE DISCOVERY:
- Not needed; this tool is the source of truth for language codes.
WORKFLOW:
- Typical flow: jems_languages_list -> pick language -> jems_project_fetch.
</instructions>
", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": []}, "annotations": {"title": "", "readOnlyHint": false, "destructiveHint": true, "idempotentHint": false, "openWorldHint": true}, "enabled": true}, {"name": "jems_auth_status", "description": "
<usecase>
WHAT: Reports whether a JEMS session is active for the current connection and which user/role is being used.
WHEN: Call before other tools if you need to confirm authentication context or debug missing sessions.
NOT: Does not perform login/logout; sessions are created automatically via headers or central configuration.
</usecase>

<instructions>
PARAM RULES:
- none; context is derived from the forwarded connection headers.
VALUE DISCOVERY:
- Not needed; the adapter resolves the current session automatically.
WORKFLOW:
- Typical flow: jems_auth_status -> ensure session exists -> call other JEMS tools.
</instructions>
", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": []}, "annotations": {"title": "", "readOnlyHint": false, "destructiveHint": true, "idempotentHint": false, "openWorldHint": true}, "enabled": true}, {"name": "jems_calls_list", "description": "
<usecase>
WHAT: Retrieves all JEMS calls (id, name, status, submission window) so you can target the right call.
WHEN: Use before jems_project_search to obtain valid call ids or to check whether a call is still draft/published.
NOT: Read-only listing; it does not create or modify calls.
</usecase>

<instructions>
PARAM RULES:
- status: optional; filter by call status (DRAFT or PUBLISHED). Leave empty to list every call.
VALUE DISCOVERY:
- Use this tool as the source of truth for call identifiers instead of guessing or hardcoding ids.
WORKFLOW:
- Typical flow: jems_calls_list -> pick call id -> jems_project_search (calls filter) -> jems_project_fetch.
</instructions>
", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["DRAFT", "PUBLISHED"]}}, "required": ["status"]}, "annotations": {"title": "", "readOnlyHint": false, "destructiveHint": true, "idempotentHint": false, "openWorldHint": true}, "enabled": true}, {"name": "jems_project_fetch", "description": "
            <usecase>
            WHAT: Fetches aggregated JEMS project details (identification, translations, work packages) for assessment or reporting.
            WHEN: Use after you already know the numeric projectId (e.g. from jems_project_search) and need the full application content.
            NOT: Do not use to discover project ids or to list projects; use jems_project_search first.
            </usecase>
            
            <instructions>
            PARAM RULES:
            - projectId: required; positive integer id of the project (example: 12345).
            - version: optional; leave empty for the latest version; format \d+\.\d+ (examples: 1.0, 2.0). Leave empty if the user is not explicitly asking for a specific version
            - language: optional; language code such as EN/DE or '*' for all translations; defaults to the fallback language.
            VALUE DISCOVERY:
            - Use jems_project_search to obtain a valid projectId.
            - Use jems_languages_list to list valid language codes and the fallback language.
            WORKFLOW:
            - Typical flow: jems_project_search -> jems_project_fetch -> downstream evaluation/summarisation.
            RESPONSE:
            - To make your output usable, always include in answers: project title/name, project acronym, version number, selected language, project status, call.
            </instructions>
        ", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"projectId": {"type": "integer", "format": "int64"}, "version": {"type": "string"}, "language": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["projectId", "version", "language"]}, "annotations": {"title": "", "readOnlyHint": false, "destructiveHint": true, "idempotentHint": false, "openWorldHint": true}, "enabled": true}, {"name": "jems_project_search", "description": "
            <usecase>
            WHAT: Searches Jems projects by id, acronym, call, objectives, status or submission dates to find candidates to inspect.
            WHEN: Use when you need to look up a projectId before fetching details or to offer the user matching projects.
            NOT: Do not use to retrieve full project details; call jems_project_fetch once you have the right projectId.
            </usecase>
            
            <instructions>
            PARAM RULES:
            - id: optional; project id as provided by Jems; trim whitespace.
            - acronym: optional; partial or full acronym string; case-insensitive.
            - calls: optional; set of positive numeric call ids.
            - objectives: optional; set of objective enums (examples: AdvancedTechnologies, ClimateChange).
            - statuses: optional; set of status enums (examples: SUBMITTED, APPROVED, DRAFT, CONTRACTED).
            - firstSubmissionFrom/firstSubmissionTo: optional; ISO-8601 timestamps; ensure from <= to.
            - lastSubmissionFrom/lastSubmissionTo: optional; ISO-8601 timestamps; ensure from <= to.
            VALUE DISCOVERY:
            - Use jems_calls_list to retrieve valid call ids and their status instead of guessing or hardcoding them.
            WORKFLOW:
            - Typical flow: (if call unknown) jems_calls_list -> collect filters -> jems_project_search -> select projectId -> jems_project_fetch.
            </instructions>

"DIGITAL_CONNECTIVITY", "DIGITISATION", "DISADVANTAGED_GROUPS", "ENERGY_EFFICIENCY", "ENV_DEVELOPMENT", "GREEN_INFRASTRUCTURE", "GROWTH", "HEALTHCARE", "ISO12_BORDER_CROSSING", "ISO12_DEMOCRACY", "ISO12_PROMOTING_COOPERATION", "ISO12_PUBLIC_AUTHORITIES", "INDUSTRIAL_TRANSITION", "INTEGRATED_ACTIONS_FOR_MIGRANTS", "INTER_MODAL_TEN_T", "LOCAL_ENV_DEVELOPMENT", "PEACE_PLUS_CO_DESIGNED_LOCAL_COMMUNITY", "PEACE_PLUS_EMPOWERING_COMMUNITIES", "PEACE_PLUS_POSITIVE_RELATIONS", "PEACE_PLUS_REIMAGING_COMMUNITIES", "PEACE_PLUS_RURAL_REGENERATION", "CONDITIONS_SUBMITTED", "CONTRACTED", "DRAFT", "ELIGIBLE", "INELIGIBLE", "IN_MODIFICATION", "MODIFICATION_PRECONTRACTING", "MODIFICATION_PRECONTRACTING_SUBMITTED", "MODIFICATION_REJECTED", "MODIFICATION_SUBMITTED", "NOT_APPROVED", "RETURNED_TO_APPLICANT", "RETURNED_TO_APPLICANT_FOR_CONDITIONS", "STEP1_APPROVED", "STEP1_APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS", "STEP1_DRAFT", "STEP1_ELIGIBLE", "STEP1_INELIGIBLE", "STEP1_NOT_APPROVED", "STEP1_SUBMITTED", "SUBMITTED"]}}, "firstSubmissionFrom": {"type": "string"}, "firstSubmissionTo": {"type": "string"}, "lastSubmissionFrom": {"type": "string"}, "lastSubmissionTo": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "acronym", "calls", "objectives", "statuses", "firstSubmissionFrom", "firstSubmissionTo", "lastSubmissionFrom", "lastSubmissionTo"]}, "annotations": {"title": "", "readOnlyHint": false, "destructiveHint": true, "idempotentHint": false, "openWorldHint": true}, "enabled": true}]};
server.tenant_id = tenant;
server.required_group_ids = groups.map(g => g.toLowerCase());
server.enabled = uuid.test(tenant) && groups.length > 0;
return [{ json: { servers: [server] } }];
